title: console: "Recently Accessed" stores a humanised machine name frozen at visit time, and rewrites the preference (audited) on every visit
body:
Path: ② the capabilities an end user meets in the app — console home | 缺项 | P2

Split by the triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` from objectui#11672 (the 2026-10-06 console dogfood sweep, showcase, framework `ce577ec4`), item 5. Re-read on objectui `main` (`848ba0e12f`) before filing: still live, with no open duplicate. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Triage: lands in `packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useTrackRouteAsRecent.ts` (`titleize`, about `:66` and `:143`–`:163`), `context/RecentItemsProvider.tsx` (about `:151`–`:164`) and `RecentApps.tsx` (about `:78`) ⇒ `domain:ui`; rationale: the label is minted at visit time from the route, not resolved from the item.

## What happens

After visiting the Delivery Operations dashboard, Team Schedule and Capability Map, `/home` lists "Showcase Ops Dashboard", "Showcase Task Schedule" and "Showcase Capability Map", and the stored `ui.recent` carries those strings. After switching to 中文 the list stays in English. Every visit PATCHes `sys_user_preference` (two identical PATCHes on one list visit), and each PATCH is audited: 32 of 108 `sys_audit_log` rows after about 25 minutes of browsing.

## Done when

- A recent entry stores identity (type and name) and resolves its label at render time from the item, in the current locale.
- A visit that does not change the list writes nothing.
- Whether preference writes should be audited at all is objectstack's question and is not asked here.
- **Pins:** the three measured pages show their labels in en and zh-CN, and revisiting the most recent item makes no write.
